mappings.reference: Company-selected ICFR scope and control framework
mappings.applicability: The control is in scope only when the adopting company determines the related system and risk support ICFR.
mappings.product_brief_summary: The POC creates reproducible evidence for a company control assessment; it does not establish SOX compliance.
remaining_validation: Confirm company-specific ICFR scope, control ownership, and operating-effectiveness test approach.
